module.purpose: Provides Angular reactive integration for TanStack DB live queries, exposing collection state and data through Angular signals with automatic cleanup via DestroyRef.
module.summary: This file exports Angular-specific reactive wrappers for TanStack DB collections. It provides the `injectLiveQuery` function with multiple overloads supporting different query configuration patterns (function-based, reactive options, config objects, or pre-created collections). The function returns reactive signals for state, data, collection reference, and various status flags (loading, ready, idle, error, cleaned-up), automatically managing subscriptions and cleanup through Angular's injection and destroy lifecycle.
module.businessContext: Enables Angular applications to use TanStack DB's reactive database features with proper reactivity and memory management. Critical for real-time data synchronization in Angular apps; failures cause memory leaks, stale data, or broken reactivity.
functions: injectLiveQuery (~L86-183): Creates reactive signals from various live query configurations with automatic cleanup

detail.signature: function injectLiveQuery<TResult extends object, TKey extends string | number, TUtils extends Record<string, any>>(liveQueryCollection: Collection<TResult, TKey, TUtils> & NonSingleResult): InjectLiveQueryResultWithCollection<TResult, TKey, TUtils>; function injectLiveQuery<TResult extends object, TKey extends string | number, TUtils extends Record<string, any>>(liveQueryCollection: Collection<TResult, TKey, TUtils> & SingleResult): InjectLiveQueryResultWithSingleResultCollection<TResult, TKey, TUtils>
preconditions: Must be called within an Angular injection context.
postconditions: Returns an object with reactive properties (data, status, etc.) that update based on query results.
edgeCases: If input is a pre-existing collection, use it directly without modification.
If input is a query function that returns null or undefined, treat as disabled query and set collection to null.
If input is reactive query options with params and query functions, and query returns null/undefined, treat as disabled.
If input is a config object with query function, merge with default startSync: true and gcTime: 0.
Any other input type or structure throws an error.
